EN: Raw magic condensed into a shard.
Water that hardens flesh against harm.

KR: 아무것도 물어뜯지 못할 때까지 벼린 강철.
EN: Steel folded until nothing bites it.
A scroll that sharpens every incantation.
The die's own luck, made solid.
Holds the front rank and never gives ground.
Picks off any column from the safety of the rear.
Sweeps the entire front column with one turn of the blade.

KR: 후열에서도 둘째 열까지 닿는 긴 창.
EN: Long enough to strike the second column from the back rank.
Keeps the line standing with light from behind.

KR: 땅을 갈라 전열 전체를 둔하게 만든다.
EN: Splits the ground and dulls everything in the front column.

KR: 가장 뭉친 열 위로 불을 떨어뜨린다.
EN: Drops fire on whichever column has clustered.

KR: 모든 칼끝을 자신에게 모아 후열을 지킨다.
EN: Pulls every blade onto himself so the rear may work.

KR: 전장 전체를 한 번에 심판하는 최종 영웅.
EN: The final hero, judging the whole field at once.
A crawling nuisance that eats through armor.
Screeches from the rear to dull your tempo.
Bones that refuse to stay down.
Arcs venom over the front line into your rear.
Works itself into a frenzy mid-fight.

KR: 전열 너머 약해진 것을 찾아 문다.
EN: Reaches past the front for whatever is bleeding.
Plated bones that shrug steel aside.

KR: 한 번의 휘두름이 두 열을 관통한다.
EN: One swing carries through two ranks.
Ignores the wall entirely and hits the back.
Holds its prey still until it stops moving.
Fills the empty slots with borrowed dead.
The warlord whose swing reaches the whole field.

KR: 아무 행동도 할 수 없다. 시전 중이던 스킬은 취소된다.
EN: Cannot act at all. Attacks and casts stop, and any cast in progress is lost.

KR: 액티브 스킬을 쓸 수 없다. 기본 공격은 계속한다.
EN: Active skills are locked, but basic attacks continue.

KR: 공격 대상을 시전자로 고정한다. 도달 범위 밖이면 무효가 된다.
EN: Forces attacks onto the caster, but only while the caster stays in reach.
Cuts attack speed by 30% per stack, up to two stacks.
Raises attack speed by 30% per stack.
Strips 30% of defense per stack, stacking three times.
Strips 30% of magic resistance per stack, stacking three times.

KR: 체력보다 먼저 피해를 흡수한다. 시전자의 마력에 비례한다.
EN: Absorbs damage before HP, scaled by the caster's MAG.
Burns for magic damage every second.
Bleeds for physical damage every second.
Restores half of the damage dealt.
Strikes the foremost living enemy from its post.

KR: 모든 열에 도달하며 기본적으로 앞의 적을 노린다.
EN: Reaches every column, defaulting to the nearest enemy.

KR: 모든 열에 도달하는 마법 탄을 날린다.
EN: Hurls a bolt that reaches any column.
Slams a front enemy and stuns it for 1 second.

KR: 화살 2발을 연달아 쏜다. 각 발이 따로 판정된다.
EN: Looses two arrows, each rolling its own checks.
Sweeps up to three vertical slots of the front column.
Skewers up to three enemies along one row.

KR: 가장 약한 아군을 회복시키고 재생을 남긴다.
EN: Heals the weakest ally and leaves a regeneration.
Cracks the front column, damaging and slowing it.
Detonates on any column, scorching three slots.

KR: 방어력을 올리고 도달 가능한 적을 모두 끌어당긴다.
EN: Raises defenses and pulls every enemy in reach.
Judges every enemy, executing those left below 30%.

KR: 피해 없이 아군 하나의 속도를 늦춘다.
EN: Slows one random ally without dealing damage.
Lobs a bone over the front line.
Targets the back column and poisons it.
Roars to boost its own attack power.

KR: 가장 약해진 적을 물고 절반을 회복한다.
EN: Bites the weakest reachable enemy and drinks back half.

KR: 같은 행의 두 명을 함께 갈라버린다.
EN: Brings the greatsword down through two enemies.

KR: 전열을 무시하고 후열을 짓밟은 뒤 돌아온다.
EN: Tramples past the front line and returns.
Forces every ally to attack it.
Crushes a front enemy for 2 seconds.
Raises two skeletons in empty slots.

KR: 대지를 내리쳐 아군 전체를 강타하고 기절시킨다.
EN: Shatters the ground, damaging and stunning all allies.
A summoned body carries only 70% of its strength.
The front rank holds twice as long.

KR: 더 크게 때리고 더 크게 맞는다.
불이 더 오래, 더 뜨겁게 남는다.

EN: The opening seconds belong to you.

KR: 주사위를 고칠 기회가 한 번 더.
EN: One more chance to fix the dice.

KR: 판 위에 주사위 하나가 더 오른다.
EN: A whole extra die on the table.
Sometimes the hand climbs on its own.
One more body on the field.
More room to hold before fusing.
One defeat is not the end.
Restores half the health of every unit.

KR: 대기석 유닛 하나를 같은 등급의 다른 유닛으로 바꾼다.
EN: Trades one benched unit for another of equal grade.

KR: 근접 유닛은 후열에서 적에게 닿지 않습니다.
EN: Melee units cannot reach from the back row.
